assign.title: Decisions: a node tool walks each one, the card shows them ranked and nested
assign.outcome:
**A decision is now made by a node tool, step by step, and the brain card shows the OpenRouter decisions ranked and nested.**

![the card's Decisions tab](/framework/ai/2026-09-29/decide-tool/shots/live-card-1920.png)

- [x] a node process walks the decision so the AI can't forget a part: [Server/decide.mjs](/Server/doc/decide.md) answers every call with what is still missing and refuses a bad part; self-test 17/17 passes
- [x] simple and concrete, ranked by how foundational: each decision is one question with a rank, shown as Rank 1, 2, 3… in the shot
- [x] nested by dependency (choose A, then decide X and Y): the proxy option leads to three decisions, own loop to one; 4 of 5 are drawn nested in the shot
- [x] confidence on every decision: 60 to 85% in the shot, with sources
- [x] saved to the card's page.jsonl: 5 decision lines on [the card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/29/openrouter-brain-a-knowledge-base-that-o/decisions/)
- [x] an interactive skill backed by the tool: [.claude/skills/decide](/.claude/skills/decide/SKILL.md)
- [x] the existing Decision view extended, not forked: [live demo](/framework/ux/Content/Decision/), zero console errors

Reviewed: 3 fixed, 2 declined, 3 noted ([review.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-29/decide-tool/review.md)).

Left: no Servex tool yet, because adding one needs a Servex restart. It is the next step.
